title: The Sermon on the Mount
description: Jesus' central teaching on the mountain, including the Beatitudes, teachings on the law, love for enemies, almsgiving, prayer and the Lord's Prayer, fasting, treasures and worry, judgment, the golden rule, the narrow gate, false prophets, and the parable of the house built on the rock.

versions.reason: [minor] references: Luke 6:20-49 is the Sermon on the Plain, a parallel text but not directly the Sermon on the Mount. It can be included as a parallel, which is fine here.; [minor] overlap: Overlaps with 'houses-on-the-rock-and-sand' (Matt 7:24-29), but the Sermon on the Mount is a much broader narrative that naturally includes its conclusion. The Sermon on the Mount is the main story, and the parable is part of it.
